name: Entity Reference Display Formatter
description: Field formatter for entity_reference / entity_reference_revisions fields that renders selected fields of the referenced entities as horizontal tabs, vertical tabs, an accordion, or anchors.

suggests.drupal/jquery_ui_tabs: Provides the jquery_ui_tabs/tabs library required by the 'Vertical Tab' display style.
suggests.drupal/jquery_ui_accordion: Provides the jquery_ui_accordion/accordion library required by the 'Accordion' display style.

project_description: Entity Reference Display Formatter adds a single field formatter (plugin id 'entity_reference_display_formatter') for entity_reference and entity_reference_revisions fields. On a view display you pick which fields of the referenced entities act as the 'title' and which act as the 'body', drag both sets into a weight order, and choose one of four output styles: horizontal tabs, vertical tabs, accordion, or anchors. At render time it loads each referenced entity, renders the selected fields, and passes them to a Twig template for the chosen style, attaching the matching JS/CSS library. Because it works with entity_reference_revisions it pairs naturally with the Paragraphs module to build tabbed or collapsible layouts without custom code. It ships only the formatter plugin, four Twig templates, and a small set of libraries; it declares no permissions, routes, services, config schema, or module dependencies.
